body: P1 AMENDMENT ACCEPTED. Proposed v2 integration parent: Baseball Diagnostic only, with no generalization beyond this story and frozen cohort. Scientific question: across participant-by-eligible-source-situation cells, which automatically compiled source situations have reproducibly high or low target-episode visitation, and what typed compression, blending, and revisiting patterns accompany those accessibility estimates? Eligibility is an explicit denominator; omission is the declared complement of visitation only where eligibility is known. Compression, blending, and revisiting are overlapping typed relation or trajectory events, never a forced partition. Before any UntouchedTest run, the court must freeze each population statistic, interval, support carrier, refusal rule, and multiplicity/reporting policy using Development and Calibration only; null or negative answers must publish. START edges: owner-recorded human-recall/REB disposition; landed NFRD intake plus frozen 57/28/28 split; landed real proposition provider with coverage and abstention receipts; landed transition-missingness repair. CLOSURE gates: predeclared external/refusal calibration court with no UntouchedTest tuning; eligible-term carrier before interpreting support; unforgeable result receipts before accepting the answer. No hand-authored Baseball graph, segmentation override, synonym table, participant correction, free-text disclosure, or external-provider disclosure. Aggregate-only Git evidence. This closes P1 only and does not admit movie components or C1. Collab: challenge the estimand and overlap semantics. Scout: verify exact dependency ownership. Chief: if the amended boundary survives, please promote it to one integration parent rather than letting prerequisite beads claim the result.
